scientific_name: Mutate geometry and query exact nearest opaque hit
common_name: Mutate geometry and query exact nearest opaque hit
scientific_use: Local GPU geometry mutation + BVH update/refit or full rebuild, with complete output and mutation audit.
scientific_purpose: Local GPU geometry mutation + BVH update/refit or full rebuild, with complete output and mutation audit.

source_references.title: Moller and Trumbore: Fast, Minimum Storage Ray/Triangle Intersection (1997)
Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)
Khronos Vulkan ray traversal and acceleration-structure updates

canonical_equations: For each explicit frame f: z=RN32(base_z+offset[(17*triangle+13*f)&1023]); offset[k]=frozen RN32(0.0025*sin(2*pi*k/1024)); query same exact static operator; every frame derives from immutable base
input_contract: static inputs plus frames[1..8] uint32; M*N*F<=1048576; mutated coordinates magnitude<=2^16 and exactly representable on 2^-56 grid; input bits retained
output_contract: F*N binary32 distances, frame-major then ray order; separate full byte audit of all F*M*9 mutated coordinates
result_contract: F*N binary32 distances, frame-major then ray order; separate full byte audit of all F*M*9 mutated coordinates
precision_requirements: Exact rational intersection on preserved binary32 inputs; canonical RN32 direction normalization and final distance. Dynamic RN32 frozen sine offset and addition. GPU signed 256-bit integer determinants; no float narrowphase, no quantization.
validation_method: Full CPU/GPU raw-byte equality for every ray and, for dynamic jobs, every mutated vertex at every requested frame, warmup and final; generic, RT update and rebuild independently checked

licensing_provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.
licensing_provenance.reference_license: Paper reference only; original exact-rational / integer implementation, no source copied

RT_backend: Conservative AABB ray-query broadphase + exact 256-bit determinant narrowphase; dynamic has BLAS and TLAS update and rebuild paths
RT_applicability: BVH prunes ray/triangle candidates; hardware-computed triangle distance is never accepted as the answer
partition_strategy: ray/frame output intervals; mutation and BVH maintenance always cover complete scene for every frame
scientific_scope: Geometric primitive / local commissioning. No public science credit; original tolerant GPU-vs-GPU tests are not independent proofs.
legacy_compatibility: Scientific operator and input representation retained; deterministic rounding/serialization strengthened. Not a claim of identical bytes to historical tolerant executors.
